items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He was Martin. How'd he call him? One of the Martins. I can't call him Martin.

ctx.x: Well who were some of the piano players he played with?
Who would those guys be? Oh man, I can't call his name. He was Martin. How'd he call him? One of the Martins. I can't call him Martin.

Was he a brother of Henry Martin? Yeah, yeah. He was Henry Martin's brother. Brother, yeah. Well then let's see, there was Coochie was a guitar player. Coochie. Coochie. Coochie was a guitar player and a piano player.
